headline: Amagi Media Labs Limited: Sale or disposal
sum: Sale or disposal - Amagi Media Labs Limited has informed the Exchange about voluntary liquidation of Argoid Analytics Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company with the effect from August 31, 2026.
